name: Enhance the River (River Health and Community Fund)
summary: Thames Water grants of up to £150,000 for catchment-scale river habitat restoration, fish passage, floodplain reconnection and invasive species work, part of a fund running to 2030. The first round has closed; later rounds are to be announced.
